reconcile.note: Gill notes Christ's body was later touched by Thomas and the disciples, so the ban applied only to Mary's moment at the tomb.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells's Skeptic's Annotated Bible presses the plain sense: Mary is forbidden to touch Jesus while the women and Thomas are invited to.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells (2013), The Skeptic's Annotated Bible.

sides.snippet: Don't touch me, for I haven't yet ascended to my Father
sides.verseText: Jesus said to her, \"Don't touch me, for I haven't yet ascended to my Father; but go to my brothers, and tell them, 'I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.'\"

sides.snippet: Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side.
sides.verseText: Then he said to Thomas, \"Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don't be unbelieving, but believing.\"
